purpose: Independent bounded observation of the current frontmost application and its ordinary onscreen windows.

serialization.stdout: exactly one compact RFC 8259 UTF-8 JSON object followed by one LF and no other stdout bytes
serialization.json: duplicate object keys, unknown keys, non-integer numbers, and values outside their declared domains are invalid
serialization.integer_domain: unsigned 64-bit integer unless a narrower bound is stated

rules: --max-windows occurs exactly once as the first argument and no other argument is accepted.
Its value is canonical nonempty ASCII decimal without sign, whitespace, suffix, or separator and parses to an integer in [1,4096].
A CLI failure still emits the exact failure output shape before exiting nonzero.

exit_status.court_rule: The court validates the output object and exact error code as the primary result; the exit status must equal this table and cannot independently manufacture a successful observation.

cgwindow_inventory.ordering: CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo rows are consumed in their returned front-to-back order and surviving handles preserve that order.
cgwindow_inventory.frontmost_application: NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication supplies the one positive process id and nonempty bounded bundle identifier used to filter the inventory.
ordinary_filter: kCGWindowOwnerPID equals the frontmost application pid
kCGWindowNumber is a unique integer in [1,4294967295]
kCGWindowBounds decodes to a rectangle with width greater than 0 and height greater than 0
cgwindow_inventory.strictness: A required field that is absent, unparseable, out of range, or duplicated is an error; it is never skipped to manufacture a complete inventory. The required-field strictness applies to every enumerated row the API returns, not only to rows that survive the ordinary_filter: an enumerated row whose kCGWindowOwnerPID is absent or unparseable produces window_owner_unknown, and one whose kCGWindowLayer is absent or unparseable produces window_layer_unknown, whether or not the row would have been filtered out. Because the requested API option is OnScreenOnly, an enumerated target-owner layer-zero row whose kCGWindowIsOnscreen value is false is an inconsistent row and produces window_onscreen_unknown rather than being skipped.

shape.frontmost_app: JSON null on an error without a valid snapshot; otherwise exact object with frontmost_app_exact_keys
shape.error: JSON null or exact object with error_exact_keys

frontmost_app_shape.bundle_id: nonempty UTF-8 string of at most 256 bytes

ordinary_onscreen_windows_shape.count: integer in [0,9007199254740991] equal to the total number of rows satisfying cgwindow_inventory.ordinary_filter before the max-windows prefix is taken
ordinary_onscreen_windows_shape.handles: unique array of integers in [1,4294967295], in front-to-back order, whose length is min(count,max-windows)

relational_rules: frontmost_handle equals handles[0] when handles is nonempty and is JSON null when handles is empty.
complete is true if and only if truncated is false and error is JSON null.
When truncated is true, error.code is window_inventory_truncated and complete is false.
When complete is true, frontmost_app is non-null and process collection succeeded without a skipped or unknown required field.
When an error prevents a valid snapshot, frontmost_app is null, count is 0, handles is empty, truncated is false, and frontmost_handle is null.
output.publication_scope: run-local probe output; raw pid, bundle_id, and handles are forbidden in the external journal and receipt

side_effect_boundary: The probe reads NSWorkspace and CGWindow state only.
It never activates, raises, orders, closes, creates, or modifies an application or window.
It never writes, removes, renames, or creates a file or directory.
It writes only the single output object and LF to stdout; diagnostics are encoded in output.error and no user title, path, argv, environment, or window contents are emitted.

court_publication.rule: Raw pid, bundle identifier, and handles remain invocation-local. The court validates the exact output and its relational rules, reduces identities with the frozen result-template digest domains, and only then persists whitelisted digests, counts, booleans, and failure facts with producer court.
court_publication.authority: This independent CGWindow inventory is authoritative for external frontmost and ordinary-window facts. A focus fixture self-report is only a consistency signal; disagreement fails the owning stage and is never resolved by preferring the fixture.

direct_inputs: exact single final foreground-probe executable bytes
input_digest_ownership.composite_digest_rule: Compute SHA-256 for contract, Swift source, build manifest, and final executable; encode the ordered array of [logical-part-id,sha256] pairs as RFC 8785 canonical JSON; then compute SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 domain agenterm.singleton-safety.v1.frozen-input, one 0x00 byte, and those canonical bytes. The independent-foreground-helper L0 member id is not repeated inside this component array.
input_digest_ownership.single_artifact_rule: Exactly one final executable artifact and exactly one independent-foreground-helper L0 member exist. Contract, source, build manifest, object files, libraries, schemas, and executable do not become separate L0 members.
input_digest_ownership.four_member_partition_rule: This composite owns only independent-foreground-helper. The process probe contract owns independent-process-helper, and the focus fixture contract owns primary-focus-fixture and secondary-focus-fixture; the four existing L0 members remain one-to-one and no fifth helper or fixture member is introduced.
